firstIrreversibleAction: No irreversible production action is approved. The first guarded write boundary is persisting a real GitHubProjectBinding or delivery cache under ~/.switchbard; production code, live config/cache writes, and any GitHub mutation require separate authorization.
approvalBoundary: This package may change tracked decision, plan, fixture, verifier, trajectory, and backlog metadata only. It must not edit production Rust or Python, mutate real ~/.switchbard state, or write GitHub.
rollback: Before implementation, revert the tracked contract commit. After a later implementation, preserve native task files and any PR references; source config is additive and cache files are disposable.
